title: Lutein Maintains Bone Mass In Vitro and In Vivo Against Disuse-Induced Bone Loss in Hindlimb-Unloaded Mice.
authors: Tanaka, Yuki; Tominari, Tsukasa; Takatoya, Masaru; Arai, Daichi; Sugasaki, Moe; Ichimaru, Ryota; Miyaura, Chisato; Matsumoto, Chiho; Ma, Sihui; Suzuki, Katsuhiko; Hirata, Michiko; Grundler, Florian M W; Inada, Masaki
one_liner_zh: 该文研究叶黄素对废用性骨质疏松的保护作用，涉及NF-kB信号通路和简单对接模拟，但核心是骨代谢生物学，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系、无结合位点预测或互作机制建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Lutein, a carotenoid, exhibits various biological activities such as maintaining the health of the eye, skin, heart, and bone. Recently, we found that lutein has dual roles in suppressing bone resorption and promoting bone formation. In this study, we examined the effects of lutein in a disuse-induced osteoporosis model using hindlimb-unloaded (HLU) mice. METHODS: Osteoclast differentiation was assessed by coculturing mouse primary osteoblasts and bone marrow cells or culturing a mouse osteoclast precursor cell line. The bone-resorbing activity was determined by mouse calvarial organ cultures. An in situ docking simulation was conducted to reveal the interaction of lutein and IkappaB kinase (IKK) beta protein. HLU mice were fed a 1% lutein-containing diet for two weeks, and the femoral bone mass was measured by muCT. RESULTS: Osteoclast differentiation is significantly inhibited by lutein, astaxanthin, and beta-cryptoxanthin. In contrast, only lutein promoted osteoblastic calcified bone nodule formation. To elucidate the molecular role of lutein, we functionally analyzed the NF-kappaB complex, a molecule involved in bone metabolism, especially in osteoclasts. Docking simulations showed that lutein binds to IKK, thus inhibiting the activation of NF-kappaB. In a cell culture analysis, the phosphorylation of p65, the active form of NF-kappaB in osteoblasts, was suppressed by lutein treatment. In vivo, a muCT analysis of the bone microarchitecture showed that lutein improves several bone parameters while maintaining bone mass. CONCLUSIONS: Lutein is effective in maintaining bone mass by controlling both bone resorption and formation, which is applied to prevent disuse-induced osteoporosis.
abstract_zh: 背景：叶黄素（Lutein）是一种类胡萝卜素，具有多种生物活性，如维持眼睛、皮肤、心脏和骨骼的健康。近期，我们发现叶黄素在抑制骨吸收和促进骨形成方面具有双重作用。在本研究中，我们利用后肢卸载（HLU）小鼠模型，检测了叶黄素在废用性骨质疏松症模型中的效果。方法：通过共培养小鼠原代成骨细胞和骨髓细胞，或培养小鼠破骨细胞前体细胞系，评估破骨细胞分化。通过小鼠颅骨器官培养测定骨吸收活性。进行原位对接模拟以揭示叶黄素与IkappaB激酶（IKK）β蛋白的相互作用。HLU小鼠喂食含1%叶黄素的饮食两周，并通过μCT测量股骨骨量。结果：叶黄素、虾青素和β-隐黄素显著抑制破骨细胞分化。相反，仅叶黄素促进成骨细胞钙化骨结节形成。为阐明叶黄素的分子作用，我们功能分析了NF-κB复合物，这是一种参与骨代谢（尤其在破骨细胞中）的分子。对接模拟显示，叶黄素与IKK结合，从而抑制NF-κB的激活。在细胞培养分析中，叶黄素处理抑制了p65（成骨细胞中NF-κB的活性形式）的磷酸化。在体内，骨微结构的μCT分析显示，叶黄素在维持骨量的同时改善多个骨参数。结论：叶黄素通过调控骨吸收和骨形成来有效维持骨量，这可用于预防废用性骨质疏松症。
